novel_claims: Block M extends ocp_const_fold with negation arithmetic: x*(-1)→0-x, x/(-1)→0-x, x%(-1)→0. Folds by in-place patching def_at[c_reg] from -1 to 0 and rewriting the BinOp to OpSub(zero_reg, x). Handles commutative (-1)*x case via symmetric s1-const guard.
Double negation elimination: neg(neg(x)) → IrCopy(x). Tracks is_neg[r] and neg_src[r] in a forward pass; when IrUnaryOp(Neg) sees src1 whose is_neg is true, rewrites to IrCopy.
x%(-1)→0 is a non-obvious algebraic identity: for all integers x, x%(-1)=0 (ISO C truncate-toward-zero semantics). Eliminates a division-class instruction with no overflow guard needed.
